description: This file defines the EnumVariable class, which represents an enumeration variable within a code generation framework. It interacts with EnumDefinition objects, generates C struct strings, Java code snippets, and handles JSON encoding/decoding for enum types. It is part of a larger code generation system for managing enum variables in a software project.

classes.name: EnumVariable
classes.description: Represents an enumeration variable that can be used within a container, capable of generating code snippets for C, Java, and JSON serialization, and resolving references to its EnumDefinition.

methods.name: EnumVariable
methods.description: Constructor initializes EnumVariable from ICEnumVariable bean, sets reference and variable name.

methods.name: EnumVariable
methods.description: Constructor that creates an EnumVariable from an EnumDefinition.

methods.name: getVarName
methods.description: Returns the variable name, or falls back to the type name.

methods.name: setVarName
methods.description: Sets the variable name and marks the instance as having a variable name.

methods.name: getEnumRef
methods.description: Returns the enumeration reference name.

methods.name: setEnumRef
methods.description: Sets the enumeration reference name.

methods.name: setDefinition
methods.description: Associates an EnumDefinition with this variable.

methods.name: hasVarName
methods.description: Returns true if this variable has a variable name and can be used in a container.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Returns a list of the enumeration values.

methods.name: resolveReferences
methods.description: Resolves the EnumDefinition reference using the Processor.

methods.name: isEnum
methods.description: Returns true, indicating this variable is an enum.

methods.name: getCtype
methods.description: Returns the C type, which is the enum name.

methods.name: getDefinition
methods.description: Returns the associated EnumDefinition.

methods.name: generateNativeLabels
methods.description: Indicates whether to generate native labels.

methods.name: generateNativeShortNames
methods.description: Indicates whether to generate native short names.

methods.name: getNativeStructString
methods.description: Generates the C struct string for the enum.

methods.name: getNativeLabelsArrayString
methods.description: Generates the C labels array string for the enum.

methods.name: getNativeShortNameArrayString
methods.description: Generates the C short names array string for the enum.

methods.name: getJavaType
methods.description: Returns the Java type name (camel case).

methods.name: getJsonKey
methods.description: Returns the JSON key name, which is the enum name.

methods.name: getJavaGetter
methods.description: Generates the Java getter code snippet.

methods.name: getJavaSetter
methods.description: Generates the Java setter code snippet.

methods.name: getNativeEncodeLines
methods.description: Generates C code lines for encoding the enum as part of native code.

methods.name: getNativeDecodeLines
methods.description: Generates C code lines for decoding the enum from native code.

methods.name: generateJavaTransport
methods.description: Generates Java code snippets for enum transport mapping.

methods.name: getJavaEncodeLines
methods.description: Generates Java code for encoding the enum into a parent container.

methods.name: getJavaDecodeLines
methods.description: Generates Java code for decoding the enum from a parent container.

methods.name: getJavaIpcObjectType
methods.description: Returns the IPC object type name for Java.
